name: The Dial
builds: Installable app shell (PWA: manifest, offline cache, GitHub Pages deploy); binary confidence call with instant reveal; scoring read from scoring.json; saved history on the phone with Export and Import; 240 verified starter questions; baseline mode with a first calibration curve; the four Unit 1 lesson cards
playable_after: Baseline sessions 1 to 3 and Unit 1 practice
exit_test: 20 calls in 5 minutes on a phone; points match the payout table to the point; installs to the home screen and opens in airplane mode; history survives closing and reopening the app and an Export, wipe, Import round trip; the coach can read your record (the export file)
retires_risk: Is the core call fast and satisfying

name: The Journal
builds: Prediction card with the six-link chain (claim, outside view, evidence with tests, case against, tripwire, number); question checker (rules in the app, with an Ask Predict hand-off for rewrites); lock; due list; resolve; edge points against a base-rate baseline; three horizons; outcome card with the table of other numbers
exit_test: 1 prediction with its full chain written in 4 minutes; due cards appear on the right day; a locked card cannot be edited; the two worked edge examples come out exactly
retires_risk: Does one prediction with its full chain fit in 4 minutes

name: The Mirror
builds: Bias map: calibration curve with sample sizes and error bars, split by domain and horizon; level; streak; 7-day score; journal-only record with sample size in the case file
exit_test: Every statistic matches an independent recomputation from the raw history
retires_risk: Are the numbers right and readable

name: The Lesson Engine
builds: Instant notes; autopsy; case file with five lenses and the rule card; pattern triggers L01 to L04 and L15; repair drills; spaced re-tests; Unit 1 gate logic
exit_test: A synthetic overconfident history fires L01 and a calibrated one does not at the simulated rates; the gate passes and fails the right synthetic players; a synthetic miss at 85% opens the autopsy and builds a case file with all five lenses
retires_risk: Do lessons fire on real patterns only

name: The Coach
builds: Private data repo and token; the record syncs to it; weekly review on a schedule: reads the record there, writes the coach letter and drill set back, checks world outcomes with sources, commits verified question top-ups to the app; daily prediction prompts, with three suggested prompts a day written at the weekly review; Predict's outside-view baselines when they arrive in time; the Ask Predict hand-off; Predict's read in the case file
playable_after: Arc I end to end with a weekly review
exit_test: First weekly letter built from your real data; the record syncs and nothing personal is in the public repo; top-up questions appear in the app; each resolved world question carries a source link
retires_risk: Can the coach loop run unattended

name: Ranges
builds: Range input; interval scoring; Unit 3 lessons and gate; triggers L05 and L06; range question bank
exit_test: Interval scores match the simulator on a fixed test set; gate logic matches the binomial table
retires_risk: Is range entry quick on a phone

name: Reasoning tools
builds: Break-it-down worksheet; chain multiplier; outside-view grading against the checker's reference class; Units 4 and 5 content; triggers L07 to L09 and L13
exit_test: Worksheet arithmetic verified on 20 known problems; the outside-view grade is computed against the checker's reference class
retires_risk: Do the tools speed real forecasts up or slow them down

name: Updating
builds: Update action with a reason (the tripwire becomes the prompt); time-weighted points; evidence-stream drills; Unit 6; triggers L10 and L11
exit_test: Time-weighted score matches a hand calculation on 5 test questions

name: Know yourself
builds: Case-against grading at the weekly review; second estimate; autopsy on every resolved case; memory check; decision card; Units 7 to 9; trigger L12
exit_test: The memory check hides the record until you answer; decision reviews come due on their date
retires_risk: Will you fill in the extra fields

name: Compete
builds: Sharp mode (log rule); 1% dial; multi-outcome questions; Predict's independent forecast (committed to the private repo before the question opens); Arena tracker; Units 10 to 12; trigger L14
playable_after: Units 10 to 12 and the public arena
exit_test: Sharp-mode points match the payout table; Predict's forecast stays hidden until you commit
retires_risk: Does the AI partner help you or anchor you
